text:
Violet: opened PR to tighten SOC2 wording in the retention matrix and to fix a broken anchor to the TTL table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1777
Harry: nice. does this change semantics or just wording? reviewers keep tripping on \"deleted immediately\" phrasing.
Violet: just wording. replacing \"deleted immediately\" with \"expired and purged per tenant TTL\" and adding an explicit legal-hold exception line. also added CLI + JS snippets showing export behavior.
Harry: can you paste the JS snippet? easier to eyeball field names.
Violet: sure:
```js
// JS v2 example
import { Audit } from '@redwood/inference';
const audit = new Audit({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await audit.exportEvidence({ tenantId: 'acme-x', pseudonymize: true, timeWindow: {from: '2025-09-01', to: '2025-09-30'} });
```
Violet: CLI example:
```bash
redwood audit export --tenant acme-x --pseudonymize --from 2025-09-01 --to 2025-09-30
```
legal-ops: prefer this sentence: \"Records expire and are purged according to tenant (customer-owned namespace) retention settings; records under legal hold are preserved until released.\" Also request we use \"pseudonymized (irreversible hash with tenant-specific key)\" when describing exports.
Violet: swapped wording and changed example output to show `pseudonymized_user_id` + `event_time` preserved. also fixed the TTL table anchor link.
devex-bot: checklist: add CODEOWNERS, include snippet unit tests, update changelog, run link-checker.
Harry: tiny nit: include the exact exported field list in a one-line mapping so SDK users can map names (user_id -> pseudonymized_user_id, email -> pseudonymized_email).
Violet: added mapping and a short note about KMS-managed pseudonymization keys in the ops runbook link. pushing update now. will ping for a final devex + legal sign-off.
